projects.title: Flashcard Practice Interface
bullets: Implemented event handling and input validation for a flashcard practice interface using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
Tested keyboard interaction and alternate input cases, and documented the interface and its local data flow.

projects.title: Course Planner
bullets: Implemented a menu-driven course planner in Python, using functions and collections for the program.
Tested representative inputs for the course planner and recorded the expected outputs for those inputs.
